name: What are the most common mobile home repairs needed after Colorado winter storms?

mainEntity.name: What are the most common mobile home repairs needed after Colorado winter storms?

acceptedAnswer.text: Colorado mobile homes frequently face freeze-related pipe bursts, roof leak damage from heavy snow loads, and wind or hail exterior punctures that lead to interior moisture rot. Because manufactured home insulation and belly boards sit directly underneath the floor, subfloor joists and insulation layers are vulnerable to trapped moisture during cold Front Range winters. When addressing storm or water damage, it is critical to verify that the underbelly wrap and floor insulation are thoroughly dried and repaired to prevent ongoing draftiness, mold development, and high heating costs.
acceptedAnswer.description: Common repairs include repairing frozen pipe leaks, restoring water-damaged subfloors, drying the underbelly insulation, and patching drywall after roof leaks.
